# Gluten Free Travel Card

> A free mobile app and website providing gluten-free restaurant cards in
> 50 languages for people with celiac disease and gluten intolerance.

- Price: free. No ads, no account, no in-app purchases, no paid tiers.
- Privacy: no data collection, no analytics, no tracking.
- Platforms: iOS and Android.
- Works fully offline; can read the card aloud in the local language; exports to PDF.
- Made by Christoph Sterkel, who has celiac disease.

## Key pages
- [Home and all languages](https://walbourg1.github.io/gluten-free-travel-card/): overview, FAQ, links to every card
- [Privacy policy](https://walbourg1.github.io/gluten-free-travel-card/privacy-policy.html)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6786020512
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.glutenfreetravelcard.app
